title: Hyundai owner's manual (US, 2026, code NE1a): Setting Electric Vehicle Specialized Functions (Battery Conditioning)
notes: Page does not name the model; NE1 is the IONIQ 5 platform code (search listing groups it with the 2026 IONIQ 5 manuals). Says Battery Conditioning can be run manually (EV > Battery Conditioning > Active) or automatically when a DC charging station is set as a destination or waypoint.
